The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Preliminary report submitted by the Mumbai Police Crime Branch found that one candidate received the question paper and benefited from it; it was not clear if multiple people had benefited from the paper leak

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Sonya Gill, AIDWA leader and women’s rights activist, dies at 70
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Co-founder of the People’s Archive of Rural India (PARI), Sonya was dedicated to uplifting women in marginalised communities

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Pune tribal students’ protest enters 13th day as talks with Tribal Minister yield no breakthrough, say students
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Vijay Waghmare, a Secretary in the Tribal Department, said that the Ministry has issued a stay order on the major demand of the students, that is, regarding the Government Resolution (GR) issued on August 14, 2026

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Bombay High Court to hear PIL against Marathi rule for drivers
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The petition challenges the August 12 notification of the Home (Transport) Department, which amended the Maharashtra Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 to include this condition for licence grants, renewals, and permit holders

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra government scraps age limit for tribal hostels after Rahul Gandhi’s letter to CM
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Tribal students to continue protest until other demands are met; BJP advises Rahul to visit the States governed by the Congress to take stock of the situation there

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra cancels ‘oral’ appointments in Ministerial offices
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: In a circular, Chief Secretary Rajesh Aggarwal directed that all such officials and employees must be sent back to their parent offices by September 10
